description: This header file defines the template class 'ScreenConnector' which manages screen frame processing, callback setting, and frame injection for a screen sharing or rendering system within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes mechanisms for handling frame queues, callbacks, and configuration validation, and references multiple external components related to screen connection and configuration.

classes.name: ScreenConnector
classes.description: A template class managing screen frame processing, callback registration, and frame injection for a specific ProcessedFrameType, supporting frame multiplexing and UI rendering within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback function to process frames, and registers a frame injection lambda with the WaylandScreenConnector.

methods.name: InjectFrame
methods.description: Injects a frame into the system, processing it via the callback if not in confirmation UI mode, and pushing it into the frame multiplexer's Android queue.

methods.name: IsCallbackSet
methods.description: Checks if the frame processing callback has been set.

methods.name: SetDisplayEventCallback
methods.description: Sets a display event callback on the WaylandScreenConnector.

methods.name: OnNextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the next processed frame from the multiplexer's queue.

methods.name: RenderConfirmationUi
methods.description: Handles rendering of confirmation UI frames by invoking the callback and pushing the processed frame into the UI queue.
